stem.text: The electric current in a wire may be calculated using the equation $I = Anvq$.

A.text: $n$ is the number of charge carriers per unit volume of the wire.

B.text: $nA$ is the number of charge carriers per unit length of the wire.

C.text: $q$ is the charge of each charge carrier.

D.text: $v$ is the velocity of each charge carrier.
